text:
alex.m: Heads up — seeing a steady increase in tiny GPU pods getting scheduled onto fresh racks instead of warm nodes in us-west1. Looks like rack-level reserve padding + slot granularity is forcing them off warm pools.
priya: Ugh, cost alarm popped for us-west1 this morning. Any precedent for this pattern?
sam: We flipped rack_reserve_padding=2 last month to reduce cross-rack noise. Side effect: small pods (~0.25-0.5 GPU) fail fit on those padded nodes and get packed into new racks.
lee: Are we observing more evictions or just worse packing (hence more expensive nodes)?
alex.m: Both. Eviction spikes ~18% for small jobs in the last 6h and new rack activation increased node-hours by ~12%. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/cluster/packing?orgId=1&var-region=us-west1 (clip).
priya: Short-term mitigation options? Drop the padding? Enable fractional packing? Tune warm-pool sizing?
sam: Fractional packing patch is non-trivial to roll this week. Quick mitigation: reduce rack_reserve_padding to 1 for us-west1 and relax the per-node min-slot from 0.5 -> 0.25 for warm nodes. I can canary that.
lee: Could we add a scheduler predicate to prefer nodes with annotation "node.k8s.redwood/warmpool=true" for pods labeled packing:small? Less invasive than fractional changes.
alex.m: That sounds useful. But need to ensure we don't starve large jobs. Also check interaction with pod anti-affinity.
sam: Plan: 1) Canary change rack_reserve_padding->1 in us-west1a,b (10:30 PT). 2) Add node annotation + scheduler hint for packing:small (non-disruptive). 3) Observe evictions, node-hour delta for 2h.
priya: I'll open the ticket and set cost-alert muted during canary. Assignments: sam -> canary PR + rollback playbook, alex.m -> monitor dashboards/alerts, lee -> runbook update for packing label.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/1278 — includes canary flag and detailed rollout steps.
lee: Quick snippet for the pod label we discussed: ```yaml
metadata:
  labels:
    packing: "small"
spec:
  tolerations: []
  nodeSelector:
    node.k8s.redwood/warmpool: "true"
```
alex.m: Ran a dry-run scheduling locally with the hint — small pods stayed on warm nodes.
priya: Timeboxed canary ok. When sam flips, mute the cost pager and drop a note in #incidents if anything weird.
sam: Canary started at 10:31 PT. Rolling back will be automated if eviction rate rises >10% vs baseline.
sre-bot: Canary change deployed to us-west1a (deploy/scheduler-canary v2) — monitoring hooks enabled.
alex.m: Initial 20m looks promising: new rack activations down ~35%, eviction delta -9%. Still watching.
lee: I'll draft a follow-up RFC for medium term: fractional packing + improved topology hints. Want better unit tests around small-gang packing.
priya: Thanks team. Follow-ups: sam to confirm rollback conditions in the PR, lee to add runbook, alex to snapshot cost delta after 2h.
sam: noted. will post results in this thread at +2h. :thumbsup:
